title: A Button Back in Place
context: Tessa 的外套纽扣掉了，朋友 Will 帮她找针线，她自己把纽扣缝回原处。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: A button fell off my coat this morning. Do you have a needle and thread?
dialogue.zh: 我外套上的一颗纽扣今天早上掉了。你有针线吗？

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: I do. Did you manage to keep the button?

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: Yes, I put it in my pocket before it rolled away.
dialogue.zh: 留住了。它滚走前我把它放进了口袋。

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: Good catch. What color thread would match the coat?
dialogue.zh: 幸好你及时收好了。什么颜色的线和外套相配？

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: Dark blue would be close enough. The original thread was blue.
dialogue.zh: 深蓝色就差不多。原来的线是蓝色的。

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: Here is my sewing kit. There is a small pair of scissors inside.
dialogue.zh: 这是我的针线盒。里面有一把小剪刀。

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: Thanks. I fixed a button before, but that was a long time ago.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我以前缝补过纽扣，不过那是很久以前的事了。

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: Take your time. You can sit at the table where the light is better.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢来。你可以坐在桌边，那里的光线更好。

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: That helps. Could you hold the coat while I get started?
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。我开始缝的时候，你能帮我拿着外套吗？

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: Sure. Let me know when you have it in place.
dialogue.zh: 当然。放到位了告诉我一声。

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.en: There, it is secure again. I will trim the loose thread.
dialogue.zh: 好了，它又缝牢了。我把多余的线头剪掉。

dialogue.speaker: Will
dialogue.en: Great job. You can wear your coat tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 做得真好。明天你可以穿这件外套了。

The coin rolled away under the chair.
This shade of blue is close enough.
Take your time choosing a color.
Hold the label in place while I tape it.

pronunciation: thread 的 th 是清辅音 /θ/，舌尖轻触上下齿之间；sewn 与 so 韵母相同，末尾有 /n/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Clothes
practice.prompt: Do you prefer repairing clothes or replacing them?
practice.answer: I try to repair small problems first. If a button comes off, sewing it back is usually easier than finding a new coat.

practice.title: Part 2 · Fixing something
practice.prompt: Describe a small thing you repaired. Say what was wrong, how you fixed it, and how you felt.
practice.answer: A button came off my favorite coat just before a trip. I found the button in my bag and borrowed a sewing kit from a friend. I chose a similar color of thread and sat near a bright window. The job took me a little while because I had not sewn recently. When the button was secure, I felt pleased that I could wear the coat again. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Repairing items
practice.prompt: Why do some people replace things instead of repairing them?
practice.answer: They may lack the time, tools, or skills to repair an item. Easy access to repair services and clear advice could make fixing things more convenient.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读借针线及请求帮忙的句子，然后说明一件衣服出了什么问题。
practice.answer: A button fell off my shirt. Could I borrow your sewing kit? I have the button, and blue thread would match.
